speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having a concerning rash and recent health changes; to help me understand your condition, can you describe where the rash is located and when it first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms (DRESS) syndrome. The combination of a new rash appearing shortly after starting an arthritis medication, alongside new onset cough, is highly suspicious for a severe drug hypersensitivity reaction. I recommend immediate cessation of the suspected medication and ordering a CBC with differential to check for eosinophilia, as well as liver function tests to assess for hepatitis.
